removeProject.title: Remove all articles from {{name}}?
removeProject.intro: Articles that exist only in this project are permanently deleted, with their analysis. Articles that are also in other projects stay there. Uploaded documents and the analysis run history are kept; this project's generated summaries, evidence and idea comparisons are cleared.
removeProject.previewFailed: Couldn't check what this would affect. Close this and try again.
removeProject.empty: This project has no articles to remove.
removeProject.activeRun: An analysis run is in progress for this project ({{analyzed}} of {{selected}} analyzed). Stop it before removing articles.
removeProject.confirmLabel: Type the project name to confirm:
removeProject.success: Removed the articles from {{name}} ({{removed}} in total).
removeProject.dangerZoneBody: Removes every article from this project. Articles shared with other projects stay there; documents and run history are kept.

errors.mismatch: The name doesn't match. Type the project name exactly as shown.
errors.activeRun: An analysis run started for this project. Stop it before removing articles.
errors.failed: The articles couldn't be removed, and nothing was changed. Try again.
